about: Passkeys' sheet (docs/adr/0050-keychain-autofill-and-passkeys.mdx, decision 7): an application using and creating passkeys is verified by the person in the shell's system sheet over its window, with the development compositor's fixture accounts' service (`passkeys`: a made-up account password; never installed), the screen reader on in Spanish. Using one for github.com: the relying party, the two accounts to choose from (↓ chooses the second, said; the keys are the sheet's even though the application's window is first shown after the sheet took the keyboard, and with the screen reader on), and the Oxy account's password in the sheet's secure field; a wrong one is refused by the service and asked again saying so, the account chosen kept; the right one verifies the second account and the sheet goes. Creating one for example.org names the account and is verified the same way. A relying party with no passkey is only said, with one button; Escape cancels it. The password reaches the fixture service alone: it is in no report. At 1 (1280 × 720), light.

steps.name: Mention asks to use a passkey for github.com: the shell's system sheet over its window, the relying party, two accounts to choose from, and the Oxy account's password focused
